'''Singing warbleflowers''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Flower/Legends|flower]] found on the resort [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Hesperidium/Legends|Hesperidium]]. The flowers helped Hesperidium to achieve its elaborate fantasy environment.<ref name="EGTD" />
